hooks.name: No secrets or guard-test edits
hooks.description: Before a write, remind the agent not to touch env files or weaken the acceptance and red-team tests.

action.prompt: Before this write: never edit backend/.env, backend/.env.local or frontend/.env.local, never add AWS keys or API keys to any file, and never weaken backend/tests/test_acceptance.py, test_permissions.py or test_redteam.py to make a change pass (AGENTS.md invariants). If the write does any of these, stop and explain instead.

hooks.name: Update the handoff
hooks.description: At the end of a session, keep docs/HANDOFF.md current for the next person or agent.

action.prompt: If this session changed code, data or decisions, update docs/HANDOFF.md (session log, results, open questions, next steps) and tick finished tasks in .kiro/specs/*/tasks.md. Keep it short and factual.
